description: The day starts with you. Set the tone. Break free from the status quo and upgrade your commute with the Tone 2 electric scooter by Schwinn. The Tone 2 makes it possible to get to work or class with effortless efficiency so you can use your day to its full potential. Just hop on the Tone 2’s lightweight aluminum frame that’s robust enough for daily use, yet light enough to carry in one hand. Use the handlebar control to select your speed (up to 15 mph) and enjoy a smooth ride on 200mm air filled tires while the rear wheel hub motor does all the work. The hand operated e-brake delivers crisp, secure stops so you’re always in control. And there’s no need for paid parking or bike racks - the Tone 2 folds for compact storage, perfect for under a desk or carrying on public transportation. The Tone 2 is powered by a rechargeable lithium battery that lasts up to 9 miles on a single charge, with an included charger that fits any standard household outlet for added convenience. You’ve got places to be. Optimize your commute with the Tone 2. Enjoy the freedom of riding a Schwinn.

components.description: Lightweight alloy frame with rear wheel hub motor and lithium battery
